channel.title: GDH industry news
channel.description: Retail, FMCG and dental industry news for brands selling in Romania, summarised by GDH.

item.title: Romanian retail sales rise for the first time in a year
item.description: Retail volumes rose 0.9% year on year in August, the first increase after twelve months of decline. Food sales are still falling.

item.title: Danish discounter NORMAL opens its first stores in Romania
item.description: NORMAL, a non-food discount chain from Denmark, has opened its first stores in Bucharest and Timișoara, while PENNY's network reached 474 stores.

item.title: Kaufland pilots an in-store beauty zone as drugstore openings continue
item.description: Kaufland is testing a drugstore and beauty area with over 600 new products in Bucharest, while dm and BIPA opened new stores the same week.

item.title: DENTA 2026, Romania's largest dental exhibition, opens in Bucharest
item.description: The DENTA dental exhibition runs at ROMEXPO in Bucharest from 16 to 18 October, covering clinical equipment, digital dentistry and laboratory materials.
